{"metadata":{"description":"Galgame / visual-novel UI plugin for the DeepSeek Harness: a whale-girl companion with animated expressions, scene-at-a-time dialogue, and an LLM emotion judge","id":"gh:1335248049","install_available":false,"language":"HTML","name":"dsh-gal","slug":"omdsh-dev/dsh-gal","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Galgame / visual-novel UI plugin for the DeepSeek Harness: a whale-girl companion with animated expr"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"essions, scene-at-a-time dialogue, and an LLM emotion judge"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"Aibo"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This repository has moved to drewnekota/aibo.** This copy is no longer maintained"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"; please open issues and pull requests there."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Give your agent a face, a voice, and a room of her own."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Aibo (相棒, partner) is a personal AI assistant that wears a galgame face. Underneath it is the DeepSe"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ek Harness (dsh) — same agent, same tools, same session, same preset. On top it gives that agent a c"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"haracter, so you can see her working, hear her answer, and keep what she made. It ships as a dsh plu"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"gin, plus a small macOS app that runs it standalone."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Desktop pet · Live character stage · Spoken replies · Lists & files · Memory · Personal data connect"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" character stage · Spoken replies · Lists & files · Memory · Personal data connectors · Computer Use"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What it is"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Two things at once."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**A personal assistant.** Not a coding agent pointed at a repository — an agent pointed at *you*. It"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" remembers what you tell it about yourself, keeps the lists and files it makes for you, and reads fr"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"om your own data: calendar and reminders, health, photos, messages, contacts, notes, mail, location,"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" home, what you read and watch, the weather where you are and where you are going. Each of those is "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"a separate dsh plugin that owns its sync and its prompt section, so the agent answers from your life"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" rather than from a search box. It can also drive your Mac directly when you ask it to."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**A galgame.** The assistant is not a text box with an avatar bolted on. It is a visual novel: a cha"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"racter on a stage, art and persona and voice shipped together as a swappable pack, reacting in real "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"time to what the agent is doing. The genre is doing real work here — a visual novel is the one inter"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"face built entirely around *one character, present, responding to you*, which is exactly the shape o"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"f a personal assistant."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Built on dsh.** Aibo adds no agent of its own. dsh runs the loop, owns the tools and the session; "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"Aibo is a plugin that mounts a UI, a store, and a persona layer next to it. Every data connector bel"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ow is its own plugin and works in a dsh session with no Aibo in it, and a dsh session with Aibo load"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ed is still an ordinary dsh session."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The conversation reads like an ordinary chat, but the right half of the window is a stage: while the"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" turn runs she is *shown* reading, writing, searching or running a command — straight from the harne"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ss's own tool events, with no side model call and no guessing. Replies are spoken aloud. What she pr"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"oduces along the way — a list, a file — becomes an object you can open later instead of a message th"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" way — a list, a file — becomes an object you can open later instead of a message that scrolls away."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Swap the character pack and the same agent shows up as someone else: art, persona and voice included"},{"id":"p13s2","text":". The pack's persona is registered as a voice-only system-prompt layer — it decides how replies soun"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"d, never what the agent does or which tools it runs."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### She is shown doing what the agent is doing"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The stage follows the tool stream, not the text. Each tool call switches her to reading, writing, se"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"arching or running; a failed call is a brief beat; an approval waiting on you is `waiting`; a finish"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ed turn is `done`. While the reply streams she is writing, and the stage directions that open her li"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"nes (`（耳根微微发红）`) pick a mood — excited, sad, surprised — that holds while she speaks the line aloud;"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" while you type, she listens. The stage crossfades between the pack's loops, so a long turn is legib"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"le at a glance instead of a spinner."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| activity | when she shows it | stands in when missing |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `idle` | the resting state between turns | `neutral` |
| `reading` | the turn is in flight: reason"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ing, viewing a file, any tool the plugin does not recognise | `thinking` |
| `writing` | the editor,"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" `present`, memory notes, any write-ish tool | `reading` |
| `searching` | web search and fetch tool"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"s | `reading` |
| `running` | shells and command runners | `writing` |
| `waiting` | an approval is "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"open on you (decide it in the dsh web UI) | `idle` |
| `failed` | a tool call errored — a beat, then"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" back to work | `surprised` |
| `done` | the turn just finished; fades after the reply | `happy` |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Activity, speech and character are tracked as one semantic state (`window.aiboCharacter.state`), ind"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ependently of how it is rendered — see CHARACTER-STATES.md."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Connectors: what she knows about your day"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"dsh is plugins all the way down, so a data source is its own dsh plugin — it owns its sync, storage,"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" tool and prompt section, and works in any dsh session. When aibo is loaded too, the source register"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"s itself and shows up in the **Data** panel (`⌥D`, `/data`), each with a "Visible to the character" "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"switch that hides it from the prompt without deleting anything."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The official set ships in this repository under `plugins/`; each is still a separate dsh plugin, bui"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"lt to `plugins/<name>/lib/index.js` and mountable on its own:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| plugin | what it brings |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| dsh-health | Apple Health pushed from the phone (Health Auto Export or a Shortcut) or imported fro"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"m `export.zip`. Weekly averages, a two-week chart, workouts, what stands out against a 28-day baseli"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ne |
| dsh-calendar | Calendar and Reminders through EventKit, every synced account. Today, next, th"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"e week; overdue reminders; tools to add and complete them |
| dsh-weather | Open-Meteo, no key. Now,"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" today, tomorrow, a 24-hour chart and the week; location guessed from the time zone. Destinations wi"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"th dates get a 16-day forecast that follows the trip |
| dsh-contacts | The address book through the"},{"id":"p23s7","text":" Contacts framework. Who a name is, birthdays coming up |
| dsh-notes | Apple Notes via Automation. "},{"id":"p23s8","text":"Search and read; create and append when asked |
| dsh-photos | The Photos library (metadata only in "},{"id":"p23s9","text":"the prompt). Photos per day, trip-like clusters, thumbnails a vision model can look at |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Status and limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- The stage sits on one fixed backdrop behind the character. There is no background picker: pack art"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" is full-frame and carries its own environment, so a separate background choice only fought with it."},{"id":"p25s3","text":"
- Idle loops are 5-second clips, not seamless cycles; the wrap is visible if you stare at it.
- Act"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ivities are whole-clip swaps, not a rig. She cannot hold a pose while lip-syncing a specific line, a"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"nd there is no per-phoneme mouth movement.
- Most connectors are macOS-only by nature (EventKit, Con"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"tacts, Photos, Messages, Shortcuts)."}],"truncated":true}
